Contract Analyst Programmer

Responsibilities

  • Perform system development, testing, implementation, maintenance support, documentation and user training

  • Work with System Analyst on web application and backend system development

  • Participate in on-going system support & enhancement

  • Conduct SIT and support UAT to ensure the enhanced systems meet the requirement specifications

Requirements

  • University Degree holder in Computer Science or IT related disciplines

  • 1-3 years of practical work experience in Information Technology; Experience in Life Insurance or Employee Benefit Insurance is a definite asset

  • Good analytical mind and problem-solving skills with a can-do attribute

  • Experience in Java, JSP, JavaScript and HTML

  • Experience in Spring Boot, Hibernate, Node.js, Vue.js, Visual Basic, Crystal report, Jasper Reporting tools is an advantage

  • Experience in developing or maintaining backend core system is an advantage

  • Knowledge in AIX/Linux, WebSphere, Oracle, MS SQL, VB.Net is an advantage

  • Knowledge of modern front-end or mobile app frameworks (e.g. Angular.js, Vue.js, React/React Native, Flutter) will be advantage.

  • Good interpersonal, verbal and communication skills

  • Good command of written and spoken Chinese and English

  • Fresh graduates will also be considered

Interested parties, please send full resume, expected salary & date available to hr-recruit@hklife.com.hk or Human Resources Department, Hong Kong Life Insurance Ltd., 15/F Cosco Tower, 183 Queen's Road Central, Hong Kong.

* Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purpose only.
* Our company will keep the data of unsuccessful candidates for up to 6 months
